name: Golden Utopia
description:
Golden Utopia

Value: 30000
Rarity: 150
Zone limit: 1

Golden Utopia is guarded by 1xAzure Dragon, 2xCrystal Dragons, 3xRust Dragons and 4xFaerie Dragons.

The reward for defeating the dragons is:
  1. 1 Combined Artifact*
  2. 3 Relic Artifacts
  3. 50k gold
  4. 20 of Wood, Ore, Sulfur, Cyrstal, Gem and Mercury

*except Angelic Aliance and Power of the Dragon Father
